title: Recipe Book Re-Organized
description: This mod fixes the Recipe Book to be more like Bedrock. All craftable items will shown first with "Show All Recipes" enabled
body:
Recipe Book Re-Organized brings a QoL improvement to the Java Edition recipe book, making it behave more like Bedrock/Console Edition.

The Problem in Java: When showing craftable items all other recipes disappear.. 
![This image shows the Recipe Book menu on the search page with the "Show Craftable Items" button enabled and only craftable items are shown.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daef2baa5df5b9137982682ec68aabedc6b810c5.png)
![This image shows the Recipe Book menu on the search page with the "Show All Items" button enabled and only locked recipes are seen on the first page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc37af23266bcc8eafc4c9bedffad5391954577c.png)

..BUT!

The Solution: I made it so that when showing all items it will sort all the unlocked recipes to be first just like on Bedrock. (I might add other Bedrock-like features that relate to the Recipe Book, but unlikely)

![This image shows the Recipe Book menu on the search page with the "Show All Items" button enabled and craftable items are shown at the start of the list then the locked recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c630a5c788e59fd7dd31a86fe5c4010b351a49a6.png)
![This image shows the Recipe Book menu on the third page with the "Show All Items" button enabled and craftable items are shown at the start of the list then the locked recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afcb0e2fb21252bdf74d28ad743575e225d4f0be.png)





Extra Notes!:

I have not tested this with many mods yet, so I'm unaware of any incompatabilites, but I would caution this with any other mods that affect the Recipe Book.
